name: @reddb/memory
description: reddb.io memory plugin — governed operational memory for code agents: markdown notes, RedDB graph memory, governed recall, lifecycle hooks, MCP/HTTP read surfaces, Workbench diagnostics, and Skill telemetry for self-improvement.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && pnpm bundle && pnpm bundle:legacy
scripts.bundle: pnpm bundle:cli && pnpm bundle:mcp && pnpm bundle:curate-skill
scripts.bundle:cli: esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --minify --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outfile=../../../dist/memory.bundle.min.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'node:module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);"
scripts.bundle:mcp: esbuild src/mcp-server.ts --bundle --minify --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outfile=../../../dist/memory-mcp.bundle.min.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'node:module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);"
scripts.bundle:curate-skill: esbuild src/curate-skill/cli.ts --bundle --minify --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outfile=../../../dist/red-curate-skill.bundle.min.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'node:module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);"
scripts.bundle:legacy: pnpm bundle:legacy:cli && pnpm bundle:legacy:mcp && pnpm bundle:legacy:curate-skill
scripts.bundle:legacy:cli: esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outfile=dist-bundle/memory-cli.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'node:module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);"
scripts.bundle:legacy:mcp: esbuild src/mcp-server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outfile=dist-bundle/memory-mcp.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'node:module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);"
scripts.bundle:legacy:curate-skill: esbuild src/curate-skill/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outfile=dist-bundle/red-curate-skill.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'node:module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);"
